pr_title: New Input Map Editor and Editor Settings Shortcut Editor
pr_body:
This PR adds UI to expose #43662 to the user interface, and it is partially dependent on #43663 getting merged, and #43663 should be merged first.

The first 2 commits of this PR are from #43663, as this UI relies on some of those changes. If you are reviewing the code of this PR, please ignore the first 2 commits.

## Features
**New Action Editor**

1. Actions can now be filtered. (Closes godotengine/godot-proposals#203, Closes #26595)
2. Built-in actions can be hidden by toggling the checkbox (Closes godotengine/godot-proposals#303)
3. Built-in actions have the icon next to them to show that they are part of the built-in actions
4. Actions and events can be reordered by drag and drop (Closes #16833)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/41730826/101419169-37fb4580-393b-11eb-9c34-9cf42abd5a50.png)
Closes #44155

**New Event Configuration Editor**
Closes #44461
Keys can be listened for as before, and then manually edited as well.
![event_config_listen](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/41730826/101419444-bfe14f80-393b-11eb-9ee5-346fc338d020.gif)

Keys and buttons can also be manually selected from a list.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/41730826/101419574-0171fa80-393c-11eb-9da1-089843d9c313.png)

**New Editor Shortcuts Editor with support for editing built-in actions**

You can now edit built in actions from the shortcut editor.
Closes the below once #43663 is merged.
Closes #17927
Closes #12164
Closes #42139
Closes godotengine/godot-proposals#1532

![editor_actions_editor](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/41730826/101427151-148bc700-394a-11eb-9776-7bebc76358ce.gif)

This PR is affected by bugs:
#44178
#44180

issue_context.title: Can't reassign "ctrl +z" and "ctrl + y" keybinds on a Swiss QWERTZ keyboard
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**
Godot Engine v3.2.3.stable.mono.official


**OS/device including version:**
Windows 10 Education N
Version 1903
Swiss Keyboard (the "Y" and "Z" keys are inverted)


**Issue description:**
Changed the keyboard shortcuts for "undo" and "redo". They accept the new keybinds, but the old ones ("ctrl + z" and "ctrl + y") remain active too.
Assigning "ctrl + z" and "ctrl + y" to different commands does not help, they remain bound to the "undo" and "redo" commands.

Note: The reason I want to reassign those keybinds is to invert them. the "Z" key is very far from the "ctrl" key on my swiss keyboard, making using the "undo" command painful in the long run.


**Steps to reproduce:**
1) Try to assign "ctrl + Z" and "ctrl + Y" keybinds to different commands
2) that's it

**Minimal reproduction project:**
[HelloGodot.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/5240992/HelloGodot.zip)

review_comments:
There's potential for some issues with this, as gamepad input is sent to all applications by the OS, so when you're testing your game with a gamepad, you might also end up changing stuff by mistake in the editor since default `ui_*` actions handle gamepad too.

But I guess let's merge and test to see what happens?

Yeah, I guess at the end of the day the current "select a button/axis from a menu" is there anyway, so reverting this shouldn't be an issue. It is very nice to have but if it causes too many issues in the editor then it should be reverted.

Nothing else should even be bound to joypad stuff in the editor though.
